name: Kitchen

dimensions.notes: The old corridor and old front room are now one open kitchen — the hallway wall has gone. Appliance bay (fridge + washing machine) beside the bathroom: 116 cm wide (measured). Other as-built sizes to measure.

orientation: Window to the front of the house (Largo Pietra Rossa); new double doors to the back terrace in the middle of the back wall

photos.caption: From the lounge doorway into the kitchen: new terrace doors on the left, kitchen on the right, washing machine + fridge at the end beside the bathroom door
New double doors to the rear terrace — fresh plaster patches and exposed wiring around the opening

current.summary: The wall between the corridor and the old front room has been removed, so the kitchen and the old hallway are one open room. Kitchen: sage-green shaker-style units with a dark wood-effect worktop, black tap, painted grey-green splashback, black glazed wall cabinets, and a peninsula with an induction hob (gloss green end panel). Floor: large light-grey tiles. The old low terrace door has been replaced by a full-height pair of wood-effect (oak-tone) glazed doors onto the rear terrace, in the middle of the hallway. At the end of the space: washing machine and a terracotta/pink fridge beside the door to the bathroom (exposed brick lintel above). The fridge/washing-machine bay next to the bathroom measures 116 cm wide.
keep: Sage-green kitchen units — a good base colour to build the scheme around
Exposed brick lintel over the bathroom door
issues: Walls patched but unfinished — plaster to be completed and painted
Ceiling: holes, cracks, loose cable ends and a mix of downlights — make good, re-plan lighting
Exposed junction box with live-looking wires above the terrace door — make safe
Fridge + washing machine stand open in the 116 cm bay — 60 cm washer + ~55 cm fridge leaves almost no side/ventilation clearance
Kitchen end panel gloss vs. matt units

target.concept: DRAFT for discussion — keep the green kitchen and finish the room around it: lime-white walls and a clean, smooth ceiling; a single run of tall built-in cupboards at the end to house the washing machine and fridge behind doors painted to match the units; a Sicilian maiolica splashback behind the sink as the one decorative moment; a runner on the hallway side and warm, simple lighting.
